en.moment_body: Brazil beaten, the whistle long gone, and a striker walks to a drum at the edge of the pitch. What follows is less a celebration than a summoning — thousands of arms pulling the same oar, a chant older than the tournament itself.
en.meta_title: Viking Row — Iconic Series T-Shirt | MOMUTO
en.meta_description: Premium heavyweight cotton tee. Viking Row, piece IM–09 of the MOMUTO Iconic Series: Norway's drum celebration after beating Brazil, drawn in expressive sketch illustration.
